answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 64 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in signal, queued in ridge, and willow publishes the wait time. A farm of 206 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3007 identities would post 3192 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
